title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
overview: Five years after the death of schoolgirl Andie Bell, Pippa Fitz-Amobi sets out to uncover what really happened to her. Sal Singh, Andie's boyfriend, admitted to the murder before taking his own life, but Pip doesn't believe he's responsible and teams up with Sal's brother Ravi to uncover the truth. If Sal Singh isn't a murderer and the real killer is still out there, how far will they go to keep Pip from finding out the truth?

title: Altered Carbon
overview: After 250 years on ice, a prisoner returns to life in a new body with one chance to win his freedom: by solving a mind-bending murder.

title: American Manhunt: O.J. Simpson
overview: The white Bronco. The gloves. The trial of the century. This documentary series investigates the shocking murder case that became a cultural phenomenon.

title: American Murder: Gabby Petito
overview: What happened in the final days of Gabby Petito's life? In this gripping true-crime series, her loved ones reveal the untold story of her tragic murder.

title: American Murder: Laci Peterson
overview: Laci Peterson was eight months pregnant when she vanished, sparking a search that ended in tragedy. This docuseries delves into the 2002 murder case.

title: American Nightmare
overview: After a harrowing home invasion and kidnapping in 2015, a couple is accused of staging the ordeal when the woman reappears, haunting the couple with a new series of tortures.

title: Amy Bradley Is Missing
overview: This true-crime series investigates the 1998 disappearance of a 23-year-old woman from a Caribbean cruise and her family's tireless search for answers.

title: Bad Influencer
overview: A single mother — and luxury bag counterfeiter — finds herself teaming up with a self-obsessed influencer to sell her bags and scrape her way out of debt.

title: Berlin
overview: During his glory days, Berlin and a gang assembled in Paris for one of his greatest plans ever: stealing 44 million euros' worth of jewels in one night.

title: Blood Sacrifice
overview: Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.

title: Bodyguard
overview: A troubled war veteran is assigned to protect a controversial politician who may be the target of a terror plot.

title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
overview: Tracing Charles Manson's rise as a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and his trial, using unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage.

title: Conversations with a Killer: The John Wayne Gacy Tapes
overview: He dined with the powerful. He preyed on the vulnerable. Beneath a smiling exterior was the horrifying darkness of a sadistic serial killer.

title: Conversations with a Killer: The Ted Bundy Tapes
overview: A unique look inside the mind of an infamous serial killer with this cinematic self-portrait crafted from statements made by Ted Bundy, including present-day interviews, archival footage and audio recordings from death row.

title: Criminal Code
overview: To crack the code of an investigation into a larger-than-life robbery, federal agents need to get creative.

title: Dark Desire
overview: Married Alma spends a fateful weekend away from home that ignites passion, ends in tragedy and leads her to question the truth about those close to her.

title: El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie
overview: In the wake of his dramatic escape from captivity, Jesse Pinkman must come to terms with his past in order to forge some kind of future.

title: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
overview: This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.

title: Homicide
overview: Detectives and prosecutors revisit their most challenging homicide cases in this chilling true-crime docuseries.

title: Inside Man
overview: A prisoner on death row in the US, a vicar in a quiet English town, and a maths teacher trapped in a cellar cross paths in the most unexpected way.

title: Juvenile Justice
overview: A tough judge balances her aversion to minor offenders with firm beliefs on justice and punishment as she tackles complex cases inside a juvenile court.

title: Keep Sweet: Pray and Obey
overview: In interviews and rare home video footage, ex-FLDS members share the truth about their isolated community — and the events that pushed them to leave.

title: Mercy for None
overview: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

title: Murdaugh Murders: A Southern Scandal
overview: Shocking tragedies shatter a tight-knit South Carolina community and expose the horrifying secrets of its most powerful family.

title: Murder Mindfully
overview: When mafia lawyer Björn attends a mindfulness class to find a better work-life balance, he discovers surprising new coping strategies — including murder.

title: My Name
overview: Following her father's murder, a revenge-driven woman puts her trust in a powerful crime boss — and enters the police force under his direction.

title: Run Away
overview: A desperate father searching for his runaway daughter gets caught up in a murder case — and stumbles upon secrets which could destroy his family for good.

title: Safe
overview: After his daughter goes missing, a widower begins uncovering the dark secrets of the people closest to him.

title: Should I Marry a Murderer?
overview: In 2020, pathologist Caroline Muirhead's fiancé, Scottish farmer Alexander 'Sandy' McKellar, confessed to her that he and his twin brother Robert had killed cyclist Tony Parsons in a 2017 hit-and-run on the A82 near Bridge of Orchy and buried the body on the Auch Estate.

title: Stay Close
overview: When Carlton Flynn vanishes 17 years to the night after Stewart Green did, it sets off a chain reaction in the lives of people connected to both men.

title: The Apartment Job
overview: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

title: The Chestnut Man
overview: At a grisly murder scene sits a figurine made of chestnuts. From this creepy clue, two detectives hunt a killer linked to a politician's missing child.

title: The Fixers
overview: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

title: The Innocent
overview: An accidental killing leads a man down a dark hole of intrigue and murder. Just as he finds love and freedom, one phone call brings back the nightmare.

title: The Perfect Couple
overview: Amelia is about to marry into one of the wealthiest families on Nantucket, until a shocking death derails the wedding — and turns everyone into a suspect.

title: The Trials of Gabriel Fernandez
overview: A boy’s brutal murder and the public trials of his guardians and social workers prompt questions about the system’s protection of vulnerable children.

title: The Witness
overview: With their 2-year-old as the sole witness to her murder, Rachel Nickell's partner fights to protect him amid a flawed investigation.

title: Trust Me: The False Prophet
overview: In this true-crime documentary, a cult expert and filmmaker infiltrate a polygamist sect to expose a self-proclaimed prophet and bring him to justice.

title: Unbelievable
overview: After a young woman is accused of lying about a rape, two female detectives investigate a spate of eerily similar attacks.

title: Banana Fish
overview: A teenaged gang leader in New York City faces his abuser and rival gangs alongside a photojournalist from Japan as they investigate a deadly new drug.

title: Chicago P.D.
overview: A riveting police drama about the men and women of the Chicago Police Department's District 21 who put it all on the line to serve and protect their community. District 21 is made up of two distinctly different groups: the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head-to-head with the city's street crimes and the Intelligence Unit that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond.

title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
overview: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

title: Detective Conan
overview: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

title: Diagnosis: Murder
overview: Dr. Mark Sloan is a good-natured, offbeat physician who is called upon to solve murders.

title: Elite Force
overview: After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

title: Graveyard
overview: Police Commissioner Önem leads a special investigations unit that solves tough cases involving violence against women.

title: Habeas Corpus
overview: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

title: Hudson & Rex
overview:
Detective Charlie Hudson teams up with what he calls his "highly trained law enforcement animal" German Shepherd dog named Rex who he prefers to team up with because he doesn't talk his ear off.

Based on the Austrian–Italian series, Kommissar Rex.

title: Human Vapor
overview: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

title: Live PD: Police Patrol
overview: An unfiltered look at police departments in action.

title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
overview: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

title: Mousetrap
overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

title: Murdoch Mysteries
overview: A Victorian-era Toronto detective uses then-cutting edge forensic techniques to solve crimes, with the assistance of a female coroner who is also struggling for recognition in the face of tradition, based on the books by Maureen Jennings.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

title: Private Eyes
overview: Ex-pro hockey player Matt Shade irrevocably changes his life when he teams up with fierce P.I. Angie Everett to form an unlikely investigative powerhouse.

title: Summer '36
overview: Nice, 1936. As workers enjoy their first paid holidays, four very different women become entangled in the murder of a prosecutor at the Riviera hotel.

title: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
overview: On December 21, 1988, Pan Am Flight 103 exploded over the small Scottish town of Lockerbie, killing 270 people. What followed was the largest murder investigation in the history of Scottish policing, into the deadliest act of terrorism on British soil.

title: The Final Problem
overview: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

title: The First 48
overview: The First 48 follows detectives from around the country during these first critical hours as they race against time to find the suspect. Gritty and fast-paced, it takes viewers behind the scenes of real-life investigations with unprecedented access to crime scenes, autopsies, forensic processing, and interrogations.

title: The Gentlemen
overview: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

title: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
overview: Through bodycam footage, texts and interviews with loved ones, this documentary investigates the horrifying murder of four University of Idaho students.

title: The Rookie
overview: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

title: Umthetho
overview: To keep their youngest brother alive, a state prosecutor becomes a double agent in her imprisoned older brother's gang.

title: Worst Neighbor Ever
overview: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

title: Wrath
overview: A wounded amnesiac finds refuge with an MMA coach and steps into the ring, torn between hope for a new future and a dangerous past that keeps closing in.
